subject: general
question:
Simplify the following:

18 - [6 - {4 - (8 - 6 + 3)}]
solution:
**Given:**

18 - [6 - {4 - (8 - 6 + 3)}]

**Formula used:**

Follow the order of operations (BODMAS/BIDMAS): Brackets, Orders (i.e., powers and square roots, etc.), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

**Calculation:**

18 - [6 - {4 - (8 - 6 + 3)}]

⇒ 18 - [6 - {4 - (5)}]

⇒ 18 - [6 - {4 - 5}]

⇒ 18 - [6 - (-1)]

⇒ 18 - [6 + 1]

⇒ 18 - 7

⇒ 11

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
